description: Documents how Workshop data is stored in the savedFile format. Covers upgrade levels, enhancement levels, preset variants of each, and tier-unlock flags.

workshopPresetName.description: List of preset name strings. The app reorders rather than renames: a preset whose stored name is exactly 'Farming' is moved to slot 0 and one named 'Tourney' to slot 1; the rest keep their stored order, and a slot with an empty/missing name falls back to 'Preset N'.
workshopPresetName.ordering: shared.resolvePresetOrder(workshopPresetName, ['Farming', 'Tourney']) → { order, indices }, where indices[slot] is the source index in the raw save list.

upgradeWorkshopLevel.description: Flat integer list — all presets' Attack upgrade levels packed consecutively. For preset p and upgrade at index i in upgradeIndices.Attack, value is at p * attackUpgradeCount + i.
upgradeWorkshopLevel.note: Non-preset fallback: used in place of presetUpgradeWorkshopLevel when the save has no per-preset data (see presetFallback).

upgradeWorkshopDefenseLevel.description: Flat integer list — all presets' Defense upgrade levels packed consecutively.

upgradeWorkshopUtilityLevel.description: Flat integer list — all presets' Utility upgrade levels packed consecutively.

presetUpgradeWorkshopLevel.description: Flat integer list — preset-specific Attack upgrade levels. Same layout as upgradeWorkshopLevel. Ignored when the save has no per-preset data (see presetFallback).

presetUpgradeWorkshopDefenseLevel.description: Flat integer list — preset-specific Defense upgrade levels.

presetUpgradeWorkshopUtilityLevel.description: Flat integer list — preset-specific Utility upgrade levels.

enhancementLevel.description: Flat integer list — all presets' Attack enhancement (Workshop+) levels packed consecutively.

enhancementDefenseLevel.description: Flat integer list — all presets' Defense enhancement levels.

enhancementUtilityLevel.description: Flat integer list — all presets' Utility enhancement levels.

presetEnhancementLevel.description: Flat integer list — preset-specific Attack enhancement levels.

presetEnhancementDefenseLevel.description: Flat integer list — preset-specific Defense enhancement levels.

presetEnhancementUtilityLevel.description: Flat integer list — preset-specific Utility enhancement levels.

upgradeTierUnlocked.description: Flat boolean list — tier-unlock status for Attack upgrades that have unlockable tiers (upgradeUnlockIndices.Attack). For preset p and unlock group at position u, value is at p * attackUpgradeCount + u. The stride is the category's upgrade count, not its number of unlock groups.

upgradeDefenseTierUnlocked.description: Flat boolean list — tier-unlock status for Defense upgrades that have unlockable tiers.

upgradeUtilityTierUnlocked.description: Flat boolean list — tier-unlock status for Utility upgrades that have unlockable tiers.

presetUpgradeTierUnlocked.description: Flat boolean list — preset-specific tier-unlock status for Attack upgrades. If all values are falsy across Attack, Defense and Utility, the non-preset lists are used instead (see presetFallback).

presetUpgradeDefenseTierUnlocked.description: Flat boolean list — preset-specific tier-unlock status for Defense upgrades.

presetUpgradeUtilityTierUnlocked.description: Flat boolean list — preset-specific tier-unlock status for Utility upgrades.

upgradeIndices.description: Ordered upgrade names per category. The numeric key is index i used in all flat-list calculations (p * categoryCount + i). Category keys match those returned by workshop.parseWorkshopData: Attack, Defense, Utility.

enhancementIndices.description: Ordered Workshop+ enhancement names per category. The numeric key is index i used in all flat-list calculations (p * categoryCount + i). Category keys match those returned by workshop.parseWorkshopData: Attack, Defense, Utility.

upgradeUnlockIndices.description: Tier-unlock groups per category. The numeric key u is the offset used in tier-unlock flat lists (p * categoryCount + u). Each entry lists all upgrades whose tier is unlocked together by that single unlock flag. The app stores only the first name of each group and matches on it, so the first entry in each list is the representative name.

presetFallback.description: If presetUpgradeTierUnlocked, presetUpgradeDefenseTierUnlocked and presetUpgradeUtilityTierUnlocked contain no truthy value, the save has no per-preset Workshop data (presets not yet unlocked). In that case the non-preset lists are substituted wholesale for their preset counterparts.
presetFallback.note: hasPresets is also returned by parseWorkshopData so the import UI can tell whether preset columns are meaningful.
